hooks.name: Keep English and Chinese strings in sync
hooks.description: When either strings.xml is saved, make sure every translatable key exists in both languages with matching format arguments.

action.prompt: A strings.xml file was saved. Compare app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml (English, default) with app/src/main/res/values-zh/strings.xml (Simplified Chinese). Every string without translatable="false" must exist in both files, in the same order, with the same positional format arguments (%1$d, %2$s, %1$.1f, ...). Add any missing translation (natural, concise Chinese or English matching the existing tone), fix argument mismatches, and keep literal % escaped as %% in strings that take arguments. Also check that no Kotlin file under app/src/main/java hard-codes user-visible Chinese text.
